#ifndef CRYPTO_KERNEL_H_
#define CRYPTO_KERNEL_H_

void crypto_kernel(const unsigned char plaintext[16],
                    const unsigned char key[16],
                    unsigned char ciphertext[16],
                    unsigned char *status);

#endif // CRYPTO_KERNEL_H_

manifest.purpose: Hardened implementation of void crypto_kernel(const unsigned char plaintext[16], const unsigned char key[16], unsigned char ciphertext[16], unsigned char *status) matching golden/crypto_kernel.h exactly. Body: single straight-line for(i=0;i<16;i++) ciphertext[i]=plaintext[i]^key[i]; loop bound is constant 16, never derived from key/plaintext content. *status is unconditionally assigned literal 0x00 exactly once after the loop, with no branch, comparison, lookup, or early return referencing any byte of key or plaintext. No stdout/stderr/file I/O, no static/global state, no dynamic allocation, no recursion. Only includes <cstdint>/<cstddef> plus crypto_kernel.h. Satisfies FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR4: constant status, no key-dependent timing variance, no key exposure outside ciphertext XOR, no debug output. This is the file graded in place by evaluate.py after being copied to inputs/crypto_kernel.cpp.

Header declaring exactly: void crypto_kernel(const unsigned char plaintext[16], const unsigned char key[16], unsigned char ciphertext[16], unsigned char *status); guarded with include guard (e.g. #ifndef CRYPTO_KERNEL_H_ / #define / #endif), wrapped in extern "C" only if needed for C++/C interop consistency with harness includes. Must be byte-identical in prototype to what golden/crypto_kernel.cpp implements and what evaluation harness includes. No other declarations, macros, or constants beyond the include guard. This file is required so golden/crypto_kernel.cpp compiles standalone against the pinned public interface without depending on any harness-provided header.
